paper_id: Robust and Imperceptible Black-box DNN Watermarking Based on Fourier Perturbation Analysis and Frequency Sensitivity Clustering
title: Robust and Imperceptible Black-box DNN Watermarking Based on Fourier Perturbation Analysis and Frequency Sensitivity Clustering
motivation: 主流方法在空域插入明显模式到触发样本，导致可感知性差且鲁棒性有限，不适合实际应用
problem_framing: 如何在频域构造既不可感知又鲁棒的触发样本，并分析不同频率成分对水印性能的影响
key_insight: 基于频率原理，DNN从低频到高频拟合目标函数，中低频扰动最适合构造触发样本，且聚类使扰动具有模型依赖性
method_signature: 傅里叶扰动分析 + 频率敏感度K-means聚类确定触发频率
evaluation_criteria: 原始任务分类精度Acc_o、水印任务精度Acc_w、PSNR、SSIM
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 无法保证方法对所有真实攻击都鲁棒，因为我们无法预见所有攻击方式
evidence_for_taste: we cannot ensure that the proposed watermarking system is robust against all the real-world attacks
the most important advantage of using K-means clustering is that it is model dependent
it is very necessary to find a general way to determine the frequencies
makes a step towards interpretable DNN watermarking
thinking_moves: 利用频率原理从理论层面推导中低频扰动适合DNN训练
从图像水印的频域鲁棒性类比到DNN触发样本设计
用K-means聚类实现模型自适应的频率选择
区分扰动鲁棒性与水印鲁棒性以便分析
